definition: Apertium is a free/open-source rule-based machine translation platform.
details: It is free software and released under the terms of the GNU General Public License.
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. That pattern-earned fluency is Apertium.
